gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

gripOrHq.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Superserum, remove all Virus counters, and avoid receiving the next two Virus counters Runner gives to you.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Downsizing
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Corporate Downsizing, show to Runner any number of agenda cards stored in HQ. Gain bits equal to twice the combined agenda points of these cards; then shuffle them into R&D.
